94:525.name: Property 1=Braid came into fruition when a group of designers and storytellers recognized how overwhelming and underrepresented textured hair education truly was. After I pitched the idea during a class project where we could form teams around concepts we believed in, that spark brought our group together for a dedicated 15-week build. What began in the classroom quickly deepened into an independent directed study, where we created our own curriculum, delivered self-defined projects, and pushed the work further with the guidance of a faculty mentor. Rooted in lived experience, community insight, and a shared commitment to bridge the gap between stylists and everyday people, we began shaping Braid into a trusted, modern resource that celebrates the beauty and complexity of textured hair.

115:983.name: I not only designed and produced all of the environmental signs for ANTIX, but I also set up the full tap to pay system for our volunteers. With almost no prior experience, I learned the tools quickly, configured every device, and ensured the system was secure and ready for show day. Balancing both signage production and payment operations allowed our team to stay organized, reduce stress, and keep the event running smoothly.
